captions.ig_en:

→ if the job's words aren't in your resume, you don't come up
→ QuickFit CV shows which ones you're missing

Try it free → link in bio ✅
💬 Recruiters: what do you search for first? 👇

captions.linkedin:
A lot of the screening happens before anyone opens your resume: recruiters search the ATS for keywords from the job.

• they search it, by keyword, like a search engine
• if the job's words aren't in your resume, you don't come up
• QuickFit CV shows which ones you're missing

One rule throughout: QuickFit CV never adds a skill, employer, date or number that isn't yours.

Free to try: https://quickfitcv.com

#jobsearch #resume #careers #ats
